newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Furnas to do Eurobond roadshow soon - report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Furnas to do Eurobond roadshow soon - report.

text.p: Brazil power generator Furnas, a unit of federally owned Eletrobras, plans to do a roadshow for its upcoming $90 million eight-year Eurobond within two weeks, Gazeta Mercantil newspaper reproted.

Furnas President Luiz Machado told the paper that company officials and representatives of J.P. Morgan, which is lead managing the deal, would meet with investors in Great Britain, Sweden and Germany during the first half of April.
Officials from Furnas and J.P. Morgan were not immediately available to confirm the report.

Furnas is raising money to complete work on its Angra II nuclear power plant, which is expected to become operational in 1999. Furnas is slated for privatization by the end of 1998, but Brazil's nuclear power plants are to remain in government hands.
